text:
tia: quick async — cross-team handshake on KV warmup tuning + kernel microbatch milestone. can owners confirm blockers and whether we can hit the sprint milestone by EOD tomorrow? cc @sam @matt @raj

sam: quick update — kernel microbatch PR merged to main (PR #489). needs full perf run; initial smoke shows 6% p99 regression on long-seq test (seq_len=4096). investigating.

matt: rolled a small canary in us-west (2 nodes) with kv-prefetch TTL change + microbatch kernels. 3h smoke: no crashes but saw tail spike synced with minor GC. collecting flamegraphs.

raj: infra note — we need the new runtime image (sha: a1b2c3d4) on staging nodes before full canary. I queued image promotion, ETA ~2h. also requires new nvidia driver flag set in node pool.

andrea: rollout plan ready: canary -> 5% now, 30% tomorrow 10:00 PT if no regressions. health checks: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, and kv-cache-hit. will open the rollout PR and add the canary config.

olivia: if p99 stays up, we should still have fallback to previous kernel variant. who owns the fallback config? @sam?

sam: I own fallback. config lives in infra/rollout config at `infra/rollouts/kernel-fallback.yaml`. quick snippet:```yaml
fallback_policy:
  - variant: kernel-v2
    trigger_p99_ms: 200
    cooloff: 10m
```

matt: dashboards to watch: `runtime/hotpath/kv-prefetch`, `runtime/kernel/microbatch-latency`, `infra/canary-alerts`. I added a temporary panel for GC-aligned spikes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy 2026-03-18T09:05Z — image a1b2c3d4 — status: success (2/2 nodes) :rocket:

sam: follow-ups I need: 1) perf run logs from eng-sre (matt can attach), 2) repro script for long-seq workload (I'll post shortly), 3) thumbs-up from infra after image promotion.

matt: attaching perf summary in a separate thread but tl;dr: p99 reg mainly in attention kernel during KV refill. suspect batching handshake timing.

andrea: I'll pause the 30% flip if we see persistent p99 delta > 5% after full perf run. will also open rollback playbook in the runbook doc.

tia: OK — plan: raj finish image promo (~+2h), sam run perf + post script, matt add perf panels + flamegraphs, andrea hold rollout window. tagging eng-sre for monitoring: @olivia please confirm alert thresholds are good.

olivia: confirmed — alert thresholds set. I'll keep pager standby for 10:00 PT flip window. if we get p99 > 180ms for 2 consecutive 5m windows I'll trigger rollback.

tia: thanks all. please update this thread when your task is done. I'll update sprint board. :white_check_mark:
